balls.text: hit towards deep midwicket, the ball travels fast off Symonds' blade and there isn't enough time to come back for the second
Rohit departs this time, another full one, he lofts it with a straight bat, but does not get enough distance on it, long on runs in to take a brilliant low chance diving forward
crash! Rohit was standing with the open stance, got a wide full toss, got front leg further away, and belted it past a helpless sweeper cover
another very full delivery, Symonds opens the face to smash it in the air to sweeper cover
digs the yorker out, opening the face to guide it to point
low full on leg stump, Rohit casually swings it in the air, splitting the gap between long on and deep midwicket, calm hitting
low full toss fired on from over the stumps, he cannot get it past the bowler, who dives to his left to stop the drive, good over from Bhatt
full ball drilled down to long off
Symonds goes hard with the turn, beating extra cover but can't beat long off
takes this flighted one from outside leg stump, turns the face of the bat and lofts with the turn past extra cover
flicked through square leg to bring Rohit on strike
pushed back toe the bowler
got him this time, Pollard goes for a big swing, it wasn't short enough and he mistimed it, the edge loops safely to point

flat, quick and wide outside off, Pollard does not any invitation, places front foot out and goes hard at the ball, which flies over wide long off, if the ball could feel, it would be feeling angry at Piyush
swung away through square leg for a single
Rohit gets the boundary, again Chawla keeps it on leg, rohit waits a moment before timing the sweep that beats deep square leg's dive to his left
wayward ball, flat, quick down leg, Pollard helps it on its way on a knee, deep square leg manages to cut it off
flicks the full ball with a flourish to long on, Pollard on strike now
low full toss, Rohit eases in to an elegant drive to long on
bat turns in his hands and he can't do much with the full toss, getting it away to midwicket
bang! it was in Pollard's slot, takes a step to the pitch and creams it on the bounce to long off
goes hard at a full one outside off but cannot get it past point
tries to go inside out over covers, the high full toss comes quickly on to him around leg stump and he turns the face of the bat to hit it straight to sweeper cover
Sachin opens up, gets front leg out of the way, and swings a full ball on one leg over wide long on from two feet outside off stump, slightly agricultural but that will be 50 for him
swat! Pollard dismisses this one as if he were dusting his house, stays in the crease and whips the length ball, and it flies over the straight boundary
stabbed away to short third man
109.5 kph from Valthaty, Pollard takes one hand off the bat as he reaches out for it, still gets enough power on the inside edge to make deep square leg run hard to his left
SAchin walks down the track, and lifts a length ball in the air, couple of bounces to long on
angles this one from a length on to Pollard's pads who nudges it behind square as it bounces on him
clips this one angled in on the pads to deep midwicket

clatter! Pollard powers a full delivery towards Piyush who gets his hands in the firing line, but the ball does not care, it was belted so hard it would have gone through a wall, that will go down as a chance, Piyush will say, yeah right
sharp turn from a length outside off for Chawla, Pollard looks to dab it away but misses
tucked away backward of square leg for a single

Dinesh at deep midwicket does what Bhatt and Harris could not, hold on to the ball, Rayudu smacked the full delivery much better this time, but Dinesh at deep midwicket took a superb high catch, tumbled down backwards with the momentum, and got within an inch of touching the rope with his hands, but did not, as numerous replays show  in the end, a charged up Dinesh throws the ball high in the air
pushes the quicker one to point

Chawla gets Rayudu to mistime this one, Rayudu lofts it high in the air, Harris at long off seemed to have it covered, but ended up getting too much inside the ropes, the ball went over his head and in to the boundary, that will be 50 for Ambati

dropped Rayudu bashes this one to Bhatt's right with lots of power, he gets both hands to it and the grenade slips from his grasp, he is left rubbing his hands and wondering why they had to get in the way
this time Rayudu gets it away, slowed down the charge down the track, went inside the line and smote it over the bowler's head
once again, Rayudu charges out and has a huge swing, inside edging it on to the pad
comes down the track and brings up the 100, pinging long off with the drive
charges out to lift him over midwicket but he bowls it flat and Rayudu mistimes it along the ground
takes it from leg stump and sweeps it to deep  square leg
goes back to one that hurries in off a length, and plonks it towards covers for a single
drives this one in the air back to the bowler, Sachin getting a bit stuck here
looks to play the cut dab past the keeper but is beaten as it hurries on and keep a bit low
Rayudu is going after everything now, charges down the track, getting too close to the ball and belts it down to long off
pushed away on to the leg side for a single
goes through extra cover, it is David Hussey who lets Sachin's drive go through his hands
PK gets away with this one, again Rayudu was eyeing the deep point boundary, but could not beat the man at point
full toss and Ambati deals with it stylishly, picks it from leg stump, shows the full face of the bat and lofts it high over the bowler's head. comfortably beating long on
even better, marginally outside off stump, enough for Rayudu, who sends it scurrying it past point with a quick swing of the arms
bosh! Rayudu gets under a full delivery and clobbers it in to the Wankhede crowd over wide long on, amazing bat speed as the ball disappears
shortish and wide, Sachin goes too hard at it and gets a thick edge to third man
cut away from around off stump, straight to point
stretches out to drive a full delivery to sweeper cover
comes down the track and drives to long on
gets a leading edge in to the covers for a single
drops this one on a length, Sachin allows it to turn, and then slaps it quickly enough to beat sweeper cover this time
super shot, drives the full delivery with lovely timing past extra cover, sweeper cover manages to stop the boundary with the dive
full delivery bashed hard down the ground to long off
Rayudu goes for another pull, this one angles in, and once again he cannot time it well enough to beat deep midwicket
now he turns it behind square leg for a run
this one is still shorter, bounces a bit more, ends up around off stump, SAchin watches it closely, sees it sitting up and pulls it powerfully wide of deep midwicket
a touch short, Rayudu was already looking for the pull, but it was flat and did  not get up much, he could not time the pull and hit it along the ground to deep midwicket
now sweeps from around off stump, there is a man at deep square leg though
whiplash-drives this full delivery in the air and wide of long off
this time HArris bowls some way outside off stump, Rayudu has a huge swing from the back foot but misses as it bounces extra
already standing way back in the crease, Rayudu is delighted to get a short delivery, and hammers it over midwicket, couple of bounces and in to the boundary
Rayudu hangs back in the crease again, this time he will get the boundary, gets front leg way outside leg stump, opens up and lifts a wide one from outside off stump wide of a leaping point
Sachin gets a single as he pushes wide of point off the back foot
clobber goes Rayudu, but long off is there in the deep and the ball goes to him on the bounce, he had got front leg out of the way, gone deep in the crease and swung hard at the ball
tucks a length ball from the back foot to a diving midwicket fielder
he had lined up the midwicket boundary, setting himself up deep in the crease for the slog-sweep, but saw this one approach quickly, and was content to push it back to the bowler
hangs back this time, and tucks it away through square leg
this one goes straight on, and has SAchin in some bother as it strikes him on the pads, would have gone down leg
short of a length and he punches it even as it stays a bit low to sweeper cover
goes very wide the angle down the leg side, Gilly cannot collect it cleanly
Rayudu waits and waits for this one to arrive around off, and dabs it almost as it reaches Gilly's gloves to short third man
a touch short and turning away, cut away to sweeper cover
now shifts his weight back and tucks this one again through midwicket to keep the strike
now Sachin goes leg side, shuffles a bit, gets across and works a length ball around off through midwicket, the man from the deep runs to his left to cut it off
shot! launches in to the extra cover drive on the up, length ball and he sends it racing after taking a step outside the crease, extra cover gets quickly to his right to field
squares RAyudu up with a short of a length delivery, he stabs it away towards point
shuffles across this time to work it through square leg, but takes it on the pads
Sachin flows in to the bereft-of-followthrough straight drive, pings it off the middle of the bat, but Harris does well to go down and stop it
the one that goes on with the arm, he goes back for the cut but it comes in to him, and he takes it from middle stump to chop it away to point
tossed up this time, he goes back and pushes it away on the off side
goes flat and on a length, Rayudu plonks front foot out and has a big swipe at it, getting it over midwicket and in to the boundary
flighted ball around off stump, he comes forward and pushes in the gap at covers
full on leg stump, Sachin capitalises on the poor line, goes down on one knee and sweeps hard and in the air, so well that it carries all the way over deep backward square leg
stays back and looks to tuck him towards midwicket, but cannot time it much further from the pitch, Gilchrist rushes after the ball as Sachin rushes back in his crease
pushes it on the leg side, but Bipul goes charging after it to cut off the single
good comeback from the bowler, gets Rayudu to come out and push this one back in the air towards him as it dips on him, on the bounce to the bowler
well done from Rayudu, lofting against the turn, full delivery pitches around middle and Rayudu clips it in the air over midwicket
goes for the cut as he sees some width outside off but chops it in to the ground
driven along the ground to long off for a single
angling this one in full from very wide of the crease, he comes forward to drive to covers
well bowled, PK, after all those deliveries around off stump, this one comes back in with the angle, Rayudu hadn't committed forward and is able to push it back down the track from the crease
Sachin's turn to play from the crease now, opens the face at the last moment to guide a length ball past point, third man runs in to field
again Rayudu stays beside the line, allows the ball to come on from short of a length, this one is a bit wide too and he steers it to third man
hardly any swing on offer for PK, Sachin pushes it towards covers and sets off for the run even as PK charges after the ball
nicely done by Rayudu, stays in the crease, allows the ball to come beside him around off and guides it towards point for a single
Sachin comes forward to  a length ball outside off, gets an inside edge that goes towards mid on from where Chawla rushes in, but SAchin is still quick enough to complete the single
this one is on middle stump, tight stuff from the Punjab bowlers, Rayudu defends it back to Bipul off the front foot
defends another flighted delivery in to the off side
tossed up around off this time, Rayudu is watchfully forward in defence

got 'em! super delivery from Bipul, it is the full length that draws him forward, comes in around middle and leg, and turns past Davy's angled blade and hits off, classical left-arm spinner;s dismissal, Bipul likes it
another full ball, that's what the spinners have done so far, this one is on leg and is clipped through midwicket
tossed up around off stump, and pushed down the track
pushes this one back to the bowler, who bangs the ball on the pitch in disgust, still smarting over the dropped chance
dropped, right past the man at slip, PK gets the edge, Davy stabs at it as it pitches around middle, Nayar cannot get down to it quickly as it flies to his left, sharp chance but could have taken
width outside off this time, and DAvy goes hard at it, the edge rolls away past keeper and the lone slip
doesn't matter if he can stand in the crease and slam them through cover as he did to this full delivery, disappeared through the infield in an instant
another one on a length around off stump, he pushes it away towards cover this time
looking for some swing, this one goes pretty straight on a length, and he pushes it back from the crease
more flight this time, he gets to the pitch and drives it down to long off, good opening over from Bhatt
bowled full again around off stump, he comes forward and pushes it away
stays in the crease and quietly nudges this one on the leg side for a tight run
bowled slowly through the air, and pitches around leg, Sachin tucks it backward of square even as Bhatt's appeal is turned down
well bowled, getting SAchin to push at it off the front foot and it turns away even as he guides it to point
full on middle and leg, he turns it past midwicket to get off the mark
good straight drive from PK off a fuller one to long on, but that is a comfortable win for Mumbai
slower one from Munaf angling in, PK backed away but could not do anything with it as it kept a touch low
short of a length and he goes hard at the pull, but the ball tamely rolls away to Pollard at deep midwicket
makes room but Munaf follows him with a low full toss, and he works it away through square leg
backs away and steers a length ball to Malinga at third man
gets under a length delivery and lofts it hard, but it just goes high and settles in to the monster hands of Pollard coming in from long on
goes hard at a full one and inside edges it towards square leg

that's the end of Marsh, and that's the game for Mumbai! pacy low full toss, Marsh tried to smash it over midwicket, but was late on the shot and looped it straight to Sachin on the edge of the circle at midwicket, 160 looks like 180 when you have someone like Malinga
clips a full one neatly off the toes, but now that he has got Malinga away, there is Pollard to contend with on the wide long on boundary, and he stops the boundary with a big dive
goes for the flick to another full delivery, outside leg this time, can't do much with it
they just keep coming, there is no getting away, another yorker is jammed away to long off
very full delivery driven away off the front foot to sweeper cover
fires in the low full toss, Chawla hits it hard but long off is very straight and gets to it
yorker from Harbhajan around leg stump, he digs it down to long on
plonked on the wicket and they rush through for the single
down the track comes Chawla, gets to the pitch and lofts nicely with the turn past extra cover, beats Rohit who charges to his right from long off and puts in the dive
Marsh can't launch in to this one, only a single to long on
tossed up slowly through the air, pushed away in front of point, SAchin lobs the ball to the keeper but MArsh is home
goes wrong for once, low full toss down the pads, he can't flick it fine
Piyush gets another one zooming in on the stumps, but he manages to get bat on it, nearly a run out but point misses with the direct hit
the inevitable has happened, slanted in from a low height, homes in flat on the stumps, Bipul can't do anything, off stump is in the way, and is uprooted
can't get him away, squeezes another full one to third man
the yorker from Malinga, but outside leg stump, he digs it away towards extra cover
low full toss that is eased away calmly to sweeper cover

gone this time, Harbhajan slants this one across Nayar as he sees him coming out, Nayar has to really stretch out to get to it, and manages to tamely push it for Symonds to take a diving catch at extra cover
the reverse sweep from Nayar, again takes it on the full, but Malinga cuts off the boundary at sweeper cover
turned away towards midwicket
thinking that Marsh will charge out, Harbhajan fires this one wide across Marsh, who hangs back, reaches out and thrashes it to the cover boundary, that will be another serene 50 for Marsh
takes this one on the full and sweeps it in the air to deep square leg
Nayar charges out, is beaten in flight, but still gets the boundary, reaches out and slices this one with the turn over point and it runs away
Marsh gets the boundary to bring up the 100, short of a length and he pulls it, getting a bit of an inside edge that goes backward of deep square leg, there is no one there
slower one again, Nayar manages to push it in front of point, initial hesitation before they set off for the run
smashed down to long off for a single this time
full and wide delivery, Marsh eases to the pitch and slaps it past extra cover, Harbhajan put in a late dive at sweeper cover but it was always going away from him
Nayar goes a foot outside leg stump, sees this one angled across and throws his bat at it, sending it through point
121.8 kph slower one going across the left-hander who looks to slog it through midwicket, but the ball barely misses off stump
shuffles to work this one but midwicket is close enough to cut off the single
Nayar with the crouching stance, gets up late and goes for the pull to a short one that rushes on, the top edge flies over the keeper
length ball that is worked away for another single
Nayar comes forward and eases a full ball past point

that is hitting leg stump if there is no inside edge, Dinesh walks across his stumps looking for the single to square leg, misses and right away umpire Reiffel raises his finger, does not seem to be any inside edge on the replays
length ball on the pads that is turned away to Harbhajan at short fine leg
misses the whip across the line, Munaf thinks that is hitting the stumps, and appeals, looked a bit high
shuffles in the crease and works a length ball behind square leg
stabbed away off the back foot in front of point
goes for the cut to a ball that is not wide enough, and is beaten

Hussey plays an ugly slog, makes room and flat-bats a short ball, gets it high off the bat, Rohit comes charging in from long off, puts in the dive and takes the ball inches from the ground, excellent catch
pushed down the ground to long off
slaps a length ball towards sweeper cover, tidy over from Pollard
shuffles and works it away off the pads in front of square leg
can;t get this one away, came forward and tried to push it past the bowler who quickly got to it
tries to angles it full and away from the left-hander who drives it along the ground to long off
comes in from a length  outside off, he goes back and plonks it on the off side close to the wicket for a single
cuts away from leg stump, he pushes it in front of point for a quick run
goes forward and looks to drive a full and wide ball, did he get an edge on that, Davy, standing up, failed to gather anyways

went again for the straight boundary, this time he did not get it as cleanly off the bat as he backed away a bit towards leg, Pollard appeared from long on and the ball disappeared in to his hands, that will be the end of Valthaty
crash! full ball from Symonds, Valthaty stands tall and creams it over the bowler;s head
Marsh does a Valthaty, goes hard at a short one, but mistimes it as it weakly rolls away to long on
length ball going across and he pushes it out to point
fullish on leg stump, and MArsh lofts it wide of long on nicely
another slower one from Pollard, stays low as Valthaty is in to the slog very early
good slower one from Pollard, Marsh picks it late and pushes it on the off side
the yorker from Pollard, he goes back and swings it down to long on
more short stuff from Pollard, bounces over Valthaty
whack! Valthaty hops in the air, gets in top of a short one and forehands it with both hands over a leaping Pollard
Marsh hangs back in the crease, lets the length ball come on and caresses it past point to third man
gentle short of a length ball, swatted away down to long on
tries to repeat the stroke, but this one is flatter and fuller, and he goes back to squeeze it down to long off
Valthaty gets another one in the middle of the bat, it was pitched up and he clobbers it over the straight boundary
flights it outside off stump, Paul goes forward and creams it, Munaf saves the boundary with more quick work, on the sweeper cover boundary
angles in to the left-hander, he makes room and punches it to long on
stands in the crease and flat-bats a length ball turning in to long off
short of a length and punched off the back foot to sweeper cover
tries to chop this one from middle stump to third man, mistimes it towards point
makes room this time and squeezes a length ball from middle stump to third man
Valthaty goes back to swinging-and-missing, shortish and outside off stump, Valthaty tries to cut but misses
132.1 kph from Munaf, short of a length from Munaf, and it takes off, Valthaty is surprised, and so is Davy as he concedes the byes
gets this one away finally, low full toss, he scythes it off the front foot, comfortably beating sweeper cover
Valthaty's struggle continues, the short ball is there to be pulled, but he gets it weakly to drop well  in front of Sachin at midwicket

goes hard at a full one outside off, slices it in the air, Munaf at sweeper cover was not going to come forward, he had planted both feet firmly in the ground, and the ball arrived to him on one bounce
slaps a back of a length ball to sweeper cover
Sachin at mid off is deep, Valthaty goes hard at it and mistimes it to Sachin, but is able to take the single
slower one, he picks it, stays back and guides it towards point, takes on Pollard with the throw that misses at the non-striker's end
clobber! Marsh shows how the pull is played, takes a step out, sees the ball is short, and immediately rocks back to thump it over midwicket, there is a man in the deep but he had no chance
goes hard at a wide one outside off, couple of bounces to Harbhajan at third man, who does well to grab it as it flies towards him
shot! full delivery and Marsh spirits forward and drives it straight past Munaf for a boundary, superb timing
another short and wide one, Marsh misses the cut, DAvy with a neat take
short and wide, but Marsh cuts it straight to point
strikes him on the pads and goes up in appeal, looked a touch high
goes hard at a pull, Valthaty, and manages to get some bat on it not enough, but gets it over SAchin at midwicket
Marsh goes hard at a length ball going across him, misses and the ball hits Davy hard on the thumb, and goes down in a lot of pain
hops to this one from back of a length on the pads but cannot work it away

dropped Munaf at cover, surprise, outs down a chance, he had to dive forward, he did, surprise, but the ball popped out of his hands, Valthaty's version of the pull had gone towards covers off an edge
eep, third time in a row, he can;t seem to put bat to ball, this one takes off from short of a length around off stump, he tries to ride the bounce and cut, misses
again, he tries to manufacture a pull-swing from the crease from way outside off, feet all over the place, beaten again
Valthaty cannot seem to connect anything at the moment, short, wide and he cuts in the air as he ball beats him
on a length around leg stump, Marsh clips him off the pads in front of square leg
pinpoint yorker from Malinga, Valthaty does well to bring down bat on it and pat it back, that;s all he could have done with it
he is looking completely at sea against Malinga, tries to drive from the crease, the full delivery rushes far away from the bat outside off stump
now the bouncer, Valthaty thought about it, and then weaved out of the line, letting it whizz past
the length ball from Malinga, surprise, surprise, Marsh plonks it down on the off side off the back foot
still no fuss from Marsh, only lovely timing, still fuller, width as well outside off, MArsh gets front foot out and pings the gap between cover and extra cover
with no fuss at all, Marsh clips a full delivery past midwicket, and once it is in the gap, the outfield does the rest
Harbhajan fires this one in from round the wicket, ends up on the pads and is flicked away through square leg
wound himself up for the big shot over the off side, but again reined himself in to push in to covers
skips down the track. Harbhajan shortens the length, he pushes it to the bowler's left and trots for the single, sees Harbhajan getting to the ball and rushes back
quietly defends another tossed up ball off the front foot,
bowled slowly through the air, he comes forward and eases it to point
a touch short, MArsh gets on top of it and cuts, but Rayudu gets to it in the covers
tries to play a weak pull shot as he sees another short one climbing, this time around off stump, but Malinga is too quick for him, what an over!
142.1 kph, now the short delivery arrives. Valthaty is caught in the crease with all those full ones, and hops in the air to fend this one down on the leg side

keeping it consistently full is Malinga, and angles this across Marsh who gets a thick edge along the ground as he pushes at it, goes past the slip, but Munaf saves some runs with some quick work at third man
146.6 kph, another ripper of a full ball, almost gets through Valthaty's defences, he somehow manages to get leg out of the way and get some bat on it to send it flying away to Munaf at fine leg
phew! 144.5 furious full toss on middle and leg, Valthaty was surprised and opened up, got a leading edge towards point as he stabbed at the ball
stays in the crease expecting the yorker, it is a full ball outside off though, tries to reach out and slap it away but is beaten
shortish and turning away, guided towards point, MArsh is sent back as he rushes out for the run, direct hit but he seems to have made it

Gilly is gone, Harbhajan strikes, Gilchrist went down for the big sweep, missed, is struck on the pads, was that going down leg? have to wait for the replays, but he is gone, what a big strike for Mumbai
pushes this one from the back foot towards covers
turns this one from leg stump in front of midwicket to get off the mark
short, wide and turning in  but Paul cannot capitalise, chopping the cut to point
turning in on leg stump, played away towards midwicket
